verdicts.reason: A: the product illustration is broken. The cream circle has separated from the can and is cropped at the bottom-left edge, leaving the can floating as an orange outline. 'Out now.' also sits low and crowded against the CTA's left edge. Even so, the headline and CTA fill the canvas with clear hierarchy. B has the same broken can/circle separation, and everything is crammed into the top ~55% of the canvas, leaving a large dead orange band at the bottom. The headline and CTA are also undersized for the format, so B looks like a shrunk copy rather than a rearranged layout.
